headline: On this Sunday, 11 October 2026
detail: Apps Court Farm's car boot page says "THE CAR BOOT IS OPEN THIS SUNDAY", so the sale is going ahead on Sunday 11 October 2026. Gates open at 7am for both sellers and buyers and the sale closes at 1pm. Sellers just turn up and are directed where to set up, with the pitch fee collected afterwards; buyers pay £2 per vehicle to park, collected on the way out to keep the entrance clear. Sales are weather dependent and the farm posts any bad-weather postponement at the top of its own car boot page, so it is worth a last look before you set off; you can also call 01932 244 822 for a recorded message confirming whether the sale is taking place.
